core_obligations: Classical square-root stability does not control the positive quantum approximation, since Weyl quantization may fail positivity. The authors propagate weighted quantum derivatives, compare square roots with positive coherent-state quantizations and close singular Coulomb commutator/error bounds to obtain the original order-hbar Wigner L2 estimate with hbar-independent coefficients.
